reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.sheet: Measured 1.60 mm sets default extrusion; supported 1.6–2.4 mm applies to five panels and carrier.
mapping.carrier: Original full surrounding frame/crossbars and four low runners per panel; 20 real Boolean-unioned runners.
mapping.tabs: Proposed, not measured: width .8–1.2 mm and height .4–.6 mm instead of source .21–.22 mm runner tops. Bed aligned; cut 1.8 mm outside edges.
mapping.interfaces: Source 4.50 ×1.70 mm sockets NOT reused; three aligned round cord-hole columns newly designed for nominal 1 mm soft cord. Bore2+.2–.8 mm printer allowance; spine inset4.5–6.5 mm; pitch7–9 mm.
mapping.originalMechanism: Five separate sheet panels form cord-ring-bound tactile flip-book: two covers plus three leaves with 1/2/3 real engraved grooves. No rigid hinge pins or dynamics.
mapping.personalization: Exact Boolean engraving on front-cover TOP. Safe radial zone6.5 mm around X=.62×leafWidth, Y=0; minimum backing1 mm.
mapping.silhouettes: Round-corner, bevel-corner and genuinely concave thumb-notch covers. No hull substitution.
mapping.deviations: No source art or mesh reused. Defective source faces not repaired or exported. Proposed cord bores/grooves and binding are original; reference carrier-and-sheet architecture is reconstructed with Manifold.

inspectedViews: evidence/reference-sections.png: actual mesh at Z=.1,.5,1.59 mm inspected before final geometry choice
sourceDefects: Actual mesh has27 edge-adjacent components, including degenerate sheets, and is not watertight. Design reference only.
